design_warnings: One or more compared groups has fewer than 6 sample rows. This is a power warning, not a universal invalidity rule; justify biological replication for the organism, variability, effect size and study design.

Recorded technical variable(s) nested within condition: batch. A condition-only model does not separate these technical effects from biology. Review the study design before inference; including a perfectly confounded term will fail the model-rank check.
Recorded technical variable(s) not included in the statistical model: batch. Review PCA and study design before deciding whether adjustment is required.
